title: An Arm That Follows a Hand: Mapping a Leader's Joints to a Follower's, Following Within Its Limits, and What Delay and a Lost Link Do

questions.question: What does the follower need that the leader does not give?
options: A model of the leader's dynamics
A faster link than the leader's
A copy of the leader's joint limits
A limit on what it may do
questions.explanation: The leader reports whatever the person does, including a slip. The follower has its own limits and a speed it must not exceed.

questions.question: A jump of 1.0 rad in the leader was followed in:
options: One tick, as a jump
0.05 s, one time constant
0.48 s at the speed limit
questions.explanation: The follower's speed is clamped at 2.0 rad/s, so a radian takes about half a second however suddenly it was asked.

questions.question: Which tracked the leader best?
options: 100 Hz with 100 ms of delay (0.168 rad)
20 Hz with no delay (0.081 rad)
100 Hz with no delay (0.059 rad)
All three tracked the same
questions.explanation: A slower rate holds the target between messages, and a delay shifts everything late. Both added to the 0.059 rad of the best case.

questions.question: With the link lost, the follower with a watchdog:
options: Went on 0.398 rad toward the last message
Moved 0.000 rad more: it held
Returned to its zero
Went limp
questions.explanation: After the timeout it stays where it is. The one without a watchdog went 0.398 rad on, toward where the leader had been.

questions.question: What does a wrong zero give?
options: An error that grows with the leader's speed
A constant offset between leader and follower
A follower that moves the opposite way
A scale that is wrong by the same factor
questions.explanation: The zero is subtracted from every reading, so an error in it is the same at every pose. Putting both arms in one known pose finds it.

questions.question: What protects a follower led into the table?
options: Contact detection and the motor limits, not this lesson's follower
The speed limit of the follower
The watchdog on the link
The zeros calibrated for the pair
questions.explanation: The follower goes where it is led. Nothing in this loop knows where the table is, so other layers have to stop it.
